:::{#def-equal-almost-everywhere}
#### Equal almost everywhere ($f = g$ $\measure$-a.e.)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
Let $f, g : S \to \reals$ be [measurable](#def-measurable-function).
The [functions](functions.qmd#def-function) $f$ and $g$ are **equal almost everywhere**,
written $f = g$ $\measure$-a.e.,
if $f(s) = g(s)$ holds [almost everywhere](#def-almost-everywhere).

:::
